records.question: 订单明细一共有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS products_cnt, SUM(sales IS NULL) AS null_sales FROM order_items

records.question: 数据库里一共有多少个客户?

records.question: 2014 年一共下了多少张订单?

records.question: 2014 年销售额最高的 5 个国家是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales),2) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-12-31'
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5;

records.question: 三个商品大类各自的销售额和总利润是多少?
records.sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales),2) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit),2) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS rows_cnt FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

records.tags: 多表/聚合/时间/枚举陷阱
records.question: 亚太市场按月的销售额趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS sales,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt,
       COUNT(*) AS item_cnt
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region
WHERE g.market = 'Asia Pacific'
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym

records.question: Consumer 类型的客户有多少个?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS consumer_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_cnt FROM customers WHERE segment = 'Consumer';

records.question: 平均折扣最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT products.sub_category AS sub_category,
       ROUND(AVG(order_items.discount)*100, 2) AS avg_discount_pct,
       COUNT(*) AS item_rows,
       ROUND(SUM(order_items.sales), 2) AS total_sales
FROM order_items
JOIN products ON products.product_id = order_items.product_id
GROUP BY products.sub_category
ORDER BY avg_discount_pct DESC
LIMIT 3;

records.question: 2014 年每个季度的销售额分别是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT (CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1 AS quarter,
       ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       COUNT(*) AS items
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2014'
GROUP BY quarter
ORDER BY quarter

records.question: 2013 和 2014 两年各自的总销售额是多少?
records.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', o.order_date) AS yr, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, COUNT(*) AS items, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.sales IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_sales_rows FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) IN ('2013','2014') GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category, SUM(i.sales) AS total_sales, SUM(i.profit) AS total_profit,
       SUM(i.profit) * 1.0 / SUM(i.sales) AS profit_margin
FROM order_items AS i
JOIN products AS p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE i.sales IS NOT NULL AND i.sales <> 0 AND i.profit IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY profit_margin DESC

records.question: 哪个商品子类的利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最低?
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category,
       ROUND(SUM(order_items.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(order_items.profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(order_items.profit) * 1.0 / SUM(order_items.sales), 4) AS profit_margin
FROM order_items
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = order_items.product_id
WHERE order_items.sales IS NOT NULL AND order_items.profit IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY profit_margin ASC

records.question: 哪些订单的发货日期早于下单日期?列出订单号。
records.sql:
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.ship_date, o.ship_mode, o.order_priority,
       c.customer_name, c.country, c.segment,
       (SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.sales),2) FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id) AS order_sales
FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.ship_date IS NOT NULL AND o.ship_date < o.order_date
ORDER BY o.order_date;

records.question: 2014 年按月的利润趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS sales,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit), 2) AS profit,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit) / NULLIF(SUM(i.sales), 0) * 100, 2) AS margin_pct,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i.profit < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_lines
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

records.question: 平均利润为负的商品子类有哪些?列出子类和平均利润。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category AS sub_category, COUNT(*) AS row_cnt, SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit, AVG(oi.profit) AS avg_profit
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.sub_category
HAVING AVG(oi.profit) < 0
ORDER BY avg_profit ASC;

records.question: 2014 年总利润为负(亏损)的商品子类,按亏损金额从小到大列出子类和总利润。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2014'
GROUP BY p.sub_category
HAVING SUM(oi.profit) < 0
ORDER BY total_profit ASC;
